items.headline: Sources: Eagles RB Barkley (hamstring) expected to practice, play vs. Cowboys
items.description: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley is expected to return to practice Thursday and is in line to play Monday against the Cowboys, sources told NFL Network's Mike Garafolo.

items.headline: Sources: Nick Sirianni, Mike Vrabel among coaches fined for conduct toward refs
items.description: Nick Sirianni and Mike Vrabel have been fined $250,000 for conduct toward officials, sources confirmed to ESPN.

items.headline: Goodell says NFL welcomes investigation into Eagles QB Hurts' medical care
items.description: NFL commissioner Roger Goodell said Wednesday that the league welcomes an investigation into the Eagles' handling of Jalen Hurts' blood clots.
